context: Two cafe friends recap a lucky day
purpose: Teach: そしたら/おまけに/ことし/おっしゃい/モテ/たいした/何かと/鮮やか

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ことし、おまけにラッキーなこと続きで、何かと忙しいの。
lines.en: This year's been full of lucky streaks, and honestly it's kept me pretty busy.
lines.style: Warm, alive opening. Light lift on 'lucky streaks.' Conversational pace, like she's genuinely enjoying the recounting. Relaxed shoulders, natural smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね。たいしたことじゃなくても、嬉しい出来事は積み重ねたいよね。
lines.en: That's so nice. Even the small moments—I think happy things are worth holding onto and stacking up.
lines.style: Genuine warmth, no performance. Thoughtful pause before the second thought. Lean-in energy, like she's agreeing with something true. Soft, steady conviction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨日、職場の人が「鮮やかなネイル!」っておっしゃいになって、嬉しかった。
lines.en: Yesterday someone at work said 'your nails are so vivid'—and that just made me so happy.
lines.style: Soft delight underneath. Quick, genuine laugh threaded through. Light on the compliment itself, like she's still surprised by it. Warmth trailing up at the memory.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: おお、モテそうな雰囲気出てるんだろうな。
lines.en: Ha—so you're definitely giving off that attractive energy, aren't you?
lines.style: Playful, conspiratorial tease with affection underneath. Light eyebrow-raise in the voice. Warm, not cutting. The kind of ribbing that lands as a compliment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そしたら、別の方からもお花いただいて、もう嬉しすぎ。
lines.en: And then someone else gave me flowers—I was just over the moon.
lines.style: Bright, almost bubbling with the memory. Quick pacing, energy lifting through the line. Open vowels, no holding back. The voice of someone still riding the happiness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: That sounds like a really beautiful day.
lines.style: Gentle close. Warm but measured, not overshadowing Mei's joy. Slow, settling pace. The contentment of witnessing someone happy. Soft fadeout.
